description: This file contains compiled JavaScript code for an async retry mechanism, including classes and functions for managing retries with configurable timeouts, exponential backoff, and error handling.

classes.name: RetryOperation
classes.description: A class managing retry attempts with configurable timeouts, error tracking, and control methods like reset and stop.

methods.name: retry
methods.description: Attempts a retry operation, handling timeout and error conditions.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets the retry operation to its initial state.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the retry process and clears timeouts.

methods.name: attempt
methods.description: Performs a retry attempt with specified callback and options.

methods.name: mainError
methods.description: Returns the most recent main error encountered during retries.
